_doc: Reusable art. A round's slot can name one of these, or give the same fields inline (inline fields override a
art         path under resources/field-markings/ (.svg .png .jpg .avif), or stock:<model>/<texture> for art
that ships in the game (e.g. stock:anzac/anzacround01), or "stock" to keep the slot's own texture
"none" = no art, just the background colour (a plain panel)
background  [r, g, b] fill behind the art - flat colour panel; omit for a bare logo on the grass
fit         contain (default: aspect kept, centred) | stretch (fill the slot) | cover (fill, cropping the art)
margin      gap around the art, as a fraction of the slot's shorter side
white       true = recolour the art solid white, keeping its shape
mark        [lo, hi] = the art is a white logo printed on a dark colour: keep only the white mark
(alpha ramps from brightness lo to hi)
invert      true = a cut-out logo (shape with see-through letters) becomes a white shape with black letters
text        a caption set to the right of the art (e.g. a slogan); font = a .ttf/.otf path from the repo root
ends        in_goal only: per-end overrides, {"neg": {...}, "pos": {...}} for the -x / +x in-goal
